entities.name: Phanariot Period & Decline
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Ottoman control tightened through appointed Phanariot Greek princes (1711 in Moldavia, 1716 in Wallachia). Fiscal exploitation, boyar resistance, and the Phanariots' paradoxical role in transmitting Enlightenment ideas. Tudor Vladimirescu's 1821 uprising ended Phanariot rule.
